decisions.statement: A member names a page property rather than a kind of value.
A member declares its own target rather than the property declaring that member.
Every member is tried at once rather than in the order the members are named.
Two members reaching one page reach that page once.
A value reaching two pages through two members is refused rather than resolved.
A property with a member that admits every value refuses nothing.

definition: a page property with a value one of its members has
